Parameter.name: prevMudAmount
Parameter.description: mudAmount from previous frame, set by LUA

Parameter.name: morphPos
Parameter.description:
X - start deforming position ( objectSpace by Y )
Y - end deforming position ( objectSpace by Y )
Z - not used
W - PushUp deformation in meters

Parameter.name: prevMorphPos
Parameter.description: morphPos from previous frame, set by LUA

Parameter.name: dirtColor
Parameter.description: XYZ - rgb color of the dirt

Parameter.name: porosity
Parameter.description: X - makes darker incoming original diffuse, porosity==1 - maximum darkening 0.5*original (wood, fabric, snow, etc)

Parameter.name: asTireWear
Parameter.description: AutoSwitch tire wear, set by LUA ( objectSpace, wheel axis X ) X - cut radius at the crown, 0 = no wear Y - radius of the profile center Z - half width of the cut W - profile exponent

Parameter.name: asTrackWear
Parameter.description:
AutoSwitch rubber track wear (motionPathRubber), set by LUA ( objectSpace )
X - ground level of the crawler ( objectSpace by Y ) = tips of the lugs
Y - cut depth plus mud gap, 0 = no wear
Z - not used
W - not used

Parameter.name: scrollPos
Parameter.description:
X - position of the caterpillar elements (scrolling time based parameter)
Y - motion_path_source (index 0,1,2,...)
Z - motion_path_target (index 0,1,2,...)
W - blending between motion_path_source and motion_path_target

Parameter.name: prevScrollPos
Parameter.description: scrollPos from previous frame, set by LUA

Parameter.name: crawlerRealLength
Parameter.description: X - real length of the crawler

Variations.Variation: // Enables vertex shader motionPath based on texture #define MOTION_PATH

CodeInjections.CodeInjection: float3 gPosMorphedByVtxColor; // morphed deformation by vertex color float3 gPrevPosMorphedByVtxColor; // gPosMorphedByVtxColor from previous frame #if defined(MOTION_PATH) || defined(MOTION_PATH_RUBBER) float4 gPosition; // positions from trackArray float4 gOrient; // rotations from trackArray float4 gPrevPosition; // gPosition from previous frame, needed for motionblur float4 gPrevOrient; // gOrient from previous frame, needed for motionblur #endif #if defined(MOTION_PATH_RUBBER) float gAsTrackCut; // AutoSwitch : lowest local y kept on the outer side (worn lugs) #endif

float mudAmount; // deform mud mesh from 0..1 float prevMudAmount; // // mudAmount from previous frame, set by LUA float snowDirtRatio; // X - Snow Amount, 0 - Dirt, 1 - Snow float3 dirtColor; // color of the dirt float wetness; // Wetness Amount float porosity; // makes darker incoming original diffuse porosity==1 - maximum darkening 0.5*original (wood, rubber, snow, etc) float4 asTrackWear; // AutoSwitch : x = ground level of the crawler (object Y), y = cut depth (0 = off) float4 asTireWear; // AutoSwitch : x = cut radius at the crown (0 = off), y = profile center radius, z = cut half width, w = exponent /* Enables tirePressureDeformation uses morphPos parameter morphPos.x - start deforming position ( objectSpace by "Y" ) morphPos.y - end deforming position ( objectSpace by "Y" ) morphPos.z - mPushOutRatio HARDCODED // relationship between deformation and mPushOut ( 0 - [do noting], 1 - [mPushOut == mPushUp] ) morphPos.w - mPushUp - deformation in meters */ float4 morphPos; float4 prevMorphPos; // morphPos from previous frame, set by LUA #if defined(MOTION_PATH) || defined(MOTION_PATH_RUBBER) /* MOTION_PATH, MOTION_PATH_RUBBER:
scrollPos.x - position of the caterpillar elements (scrolling time based parameter) scrollPos.y - motion_path_source (index 0,1,2,...) scrollPos.z - motion_path_target (index 0,1,2,...) scrollPos.w - blending between motion_path_source and motion_path_target */ float4 scrollPos; float4 prevScrollPos; // scrollPos from previous frame, set by LUA, needed for TAA #endif #if defined(MOTION_PATH_RUBBER) float crawlerRealLength; // X - real length of the crawler #endif
float3 localPosition : TEXCOORDn; float3 localNormal : TEXCOORDn;
